deckName: KS3 DT · J2 Lesson 6 — Festival Planner (Teacher Deck)

slides.kicker: OUR LADY'S GRAMMAR SCHOOL · DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY
slides.heading: The Headliner
slides.sub: Today you make a computer do your sums for you. When one number changes, it redoes every sum on its own. People use spreadsheets to plan parties, trips and whole festivals.
slides.notes:
WHERE THE CLASS IS: the class is coming in, logging in and opening the class link. The lesson opens on the Do-Now: five questions from earlier lessons that mark themselves. Take the register while the class works on it.

SAY: read the sentences on the slide aloud, once, then stop. Say nothing about what happens on screen. The hour is a surprise.

slides.heading: What you will do today
bullets: Write a sum that uses box names, like =B3*C3.
Change one number and watch every sum change.
Copy a sum down a column.
Make a box answer in words with IF.
Pin a box with $ signs so it does not move when you copy a sum.
slides.notes: SAY: these are the five things. Do not explain them now. The screens teach them one at a time, with an example before every task.

slides.heading: Headphones on
bullets: The hour has sound. Put your headphones on now.
No headphones? Press the speaker button to turn sound off.
Every sound also has its words on the screen. With the sound off, you can still read every word.
slides.notes: SAY: headphones on. If you have none, turn the sound off with the speaker button.

slides.heading: On your own
bullets: You work through your own screens at your own pace.
Stuck? Press Give me a hint. The last hint shows the exact sum.
Hints never cost you anything.
slides.notes: SAY: this is your own hour. Stuck means press the hint button, not put your hand up.

slides.heading: Read every screen
bullets: Every screen says what to do and when it is done.
The strip at the top shows which part you are in.
Lost? Read the screen again from the top.
slides.notes: SAY: nothing on these screens is decoration. Read every line.

slides.heading: Start now
bullets: Open the link and sign in with your school account.
Start with the five warm-up questions.
When a screen says Finish, you are done.
slides.notes: SAY: go. Leave the deck on this slide for the rest of the hour.

slides.heading: The last screens
bullets: When you reach the badges, you are nearly finished.
You answer five last questions about today. Then you fill in a short page about how it went.
Press Finish. Everything you made is saved.
slides.notes: SAY: when you see your badges, you have about ten minutes left. Finish the last questions.

slides.heading: Before you leave
bullets: Your work is saved. You have nothing to print.
Finished early? The last screen offers more to try.
slides.notes: SAY: everything is saved. See you in a fortnight.
